en: Black‑and‑white (tinted) postcard view of a riverside cityscape. In the background on a hill stands a large Gothic and Renaissance complex with multiple spires, identified as the royal Albrechtsburg overlooking the river. Below are dense town buildings and a stone bridge crossing the river. In the foreground on the water are a long paddle steamer and moored boats. The title text appears in red at the top and along the left edge, with a handwritten number in red ink at the upper right.
